definition_zh: v. 压缩，使收缩；限制，束缚
definition_en: to make something narrow or tight
core_image: 一条绳子越勒越紧，通道被压窄
scene: 低温使血管收缩，手因此发白。Cold constricts the blood vessels, and the hands turn pale.

senses.definition: to make a passage or body part narrower

senses.why: Latin constringere means to bind tight.

senses.title: Hold back

senses.example: Rules constrict the market.

senses.why: A tight band becomes a tight rule.
senses.whyCN: 勒紧的带子变成收紧的规则。

definition_en: to build something by putting parts together, or to form an idea in the mind
core_image: 工人把钢梁一根根吊起，拼成桥的骨架
scene: 工地上的吊车正把钢梁送到桥墩上。Workers construct the bridge in sections.
sceneCN: 这里 construct 指「建造」（第 1 个义项：把材料拼成建筑物）；句意是工人们分段建造这座桥。

senses.title: Build from parts
senses.definition: to build a physical thing by joining materials together
senses.definitionCN: 把材料连接起来建成实物
senses.example: They plan to construct a new school here.
senses.exampleCN: 他们计划在这里建一所新学校。
senses.why: Nothing large appears at once; it is lifted piece by piece.
senses.whyCN: 庞大的东西不会一下出现，而是一块块吊起来。

senses.title: Build in the mind
senses.definition: to form an idea, theory or sentence out of separate parts
senses.definitionCN: 用分散的部分搭出想法、理论或句子
senses.example: She constructed a clear argument from three facts.
senses.exampleCN: 她用三件事实构建了一个清晰的论证。
senses.why: Thought also needs a frame before it can stand.
senses.whyCN: 想法也要先有个架子，才能立起来。

senses.title: Draw by rule
senses.definition: to draw a geometric figure exactly as the rules require
senses.definitionCN: 严格按规则画出几何图形
senses.example: Construct a triangle with these two sides.
senses.exampleCN: 用这两条边作一个三角形。
senses.why: Geometry builds shapes with a ruler and a compass.
senses.whyCN: 几何用尺和圆规把图形搭建出来。

intro.en: Construct comes from Latin construere, to pile up or build, built from com-, together, and struere, to pile.
intro.cn: construct 来自拉丁语 construere，意为堆起或建造，由 com-（一起）与 struere（堆积）构成。

items.en: Struere meant to pile things in layers.
items.cn: struere 意为把东西一层层堆起。

items.en: Construere meant to pile materials into a building.
items.cn: construere 意为把材料堆成一座建筑。

items.en: It also described putting words together in order.
items.cn: 它也描述把词语按顺序组合起来。

items.en: French construire kept both the building and the wording senses.
items.cn: 法语 construire 同时保留建造与组句两层意思。

items.en: English construct meant to build up a structure.
items.cn: 英语 construct 指搭起一座结构。

items.en: It now also covers building an argument or a theory.
items.cn: 如今它也指构建论证或理论。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin pile base struct-, and the meaning group names other verbs for putting a thing together.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语堆积词基 struct-，近义组列出其他表示把事物搭起来的动词。

branches.en: A fasces carried before a consul.
branches.cn: 执政官前举着的束棒。

intro.en: Consul shares its root with consult and counsel.
intro.cn: consul 与 consult、counsel 共享词根。

latinIntro.en: Latin consulere is to take counsel and consul is the counsellor.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 consulere 意为商议，consul 指商议者。

definition_en: to ask someone for advice, or to look something up for information
core_image: 一个人拿着地图，向路边的老人问路
scene: 出发前，他先给当地的朋友打了个电话。You should consult a doctor before taking the pills.
sceneCN: 这里 consult 指「咨询、请教」（第 1 个义项：向人求取意见）；句意是吃药前你应当咨询医生。

senses.title: Ask for advice
senses.definition: to ask a person with knowledge for their opinion
senses.definitionCN: 向有知识的人征询意见
senses.example: Consult a doctor if the pain continues.
senses.exampleCN: 如果疼痛持续，请咨询医生。
senses.why: No one carries every answer, so some answers must be asked for.
senses.whyCN: 没人能带着所有答案，所以有些答案必须去问。

senses.title: Look it up
senses.definition: to search a book or record for information
senses.definitionCN: 在书本或记录中查找信息
senses.example: He consulted the map before setting out.
senses.exampleCN: 出发前他查了地图。
senses.why: A dictionary is advice that has been waiting quietly.
senses.whyCN: 词典是一份安静等候着的意见。

senses.title: Talk it over
senses.definition: to discuss something with others before deciding
senses.definitionCN: 做决定前与他人一起讨论
senses.example: The mayor consulted with local groups.
senses.exampleCN: 市长与当地团体进行了商议。
senses.why: A decision shared before it is made is harder to resent later.
senses.whyCN: 做决定前先商量，日后就不容易招怨。

intro.en: Consult comes from Latin consultare, to take counsel, a frequent form of consulere, to gather and deliberate.
intro.cn: consult 来自拉丁语 consultare，意为商议，是 consulere（聚集商议）的反复形式。

items.en: Consulere meant to gather people to deliberate.
items.cn: consulere 意为召集众人商议。

items.en: It also meant to look after the interests of someone.
items.cn: 它也指照看某人的利益。

items.en: Consultare repeated the act of asking for counsel.
items.cn: consultare 表示反复地征询意见。

items.en: French consulter carried the word into advice and books.
items.cn: 法语 consulter 把这个词带到求教与查书。

items.en: English consult meant to seek advice from a person.
items.cn: 英语 consult 指向人求教。

items.en: It now also covers checking a map, a file or a record.
items.cn: 如今它也指查地图、查档案或查记录。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin counsel base, and the meaning group names other verbs for seeking information or advice.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的商议词基，近义组列出其他表示求取信息或意见的动词。

entries.definition: an expert who gives professional advice
a meeting to seek advice or decide together
to speak to someone in a rude way
to say that you want information or help
to discuss something with others

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a question put to a stranger, then move to a page searched for a fact and to a table where people talk it over.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从向陌生人提出的问题开始，再到为找一个事实而翻开的书页，最后到众人商谈的桌子。

normal.en: Con- is together and sult is gather, so consult is gathering advice from someone.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，sult 是聚集，consult 就是把意见聚拢过来。

normal.en: A map held open at a crossroads: that is consult.
normal.cn: 在十字路口摊开一张地图，那就是查阅。

normal.en: Ask before you act, and you have consulted.
normal.cn: 动手之前先问过，你就已经咨询过了。

normal.en: A dictionary is a quiet consultant on the shelf.
normal.cn: 词典是书架上一位安静的顾问。

normal.en: Two heads talking before one hand moves.
normal.cn: 两只脑袋先商量，一只手再行动。

abstract.en: Picture a finger running down a list of names.
abstract.cn: 想象一根手指顺着一列名字往下滑。

abstract.en: Picture a phone held to an ear in a hallway.
abstract.cn: 想象走廊里贴着耳朵的手机。

abstract.en: Picture a book opened flat beside a cold cup.
abstract.cn: 想象一本摊平的书旁边放着一杯凉茶。

examples.en: You had better consult a specialist about the pain.
examples.cn: 关于这处疼痛，你最好咨询专科医生。

examples.en: She consulted the dictionary for the exact meaning.
examples.cn: 她查词典确认准确含义。

examples.en: The committee consulted with parents before changing the rules.
examples.cn: 委员会在修改规定前与家长进行了商议。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 consult 记成 con（一起）加 sult（聚集）：把懂行的人聚到一起问个明白，就是咨询、请教。

root: 源自拉丁语 consultare（反复商议），本义是聚在一起商量，后指向人请教、查阅资料与共同商议。

sensesIntro.en: From a question put to an expert, to a fact hunted down in a book, and to people sitting together before a decision.
sensesIntro.cn: 从向专家提出的问题，到书里找出的一个事实，最后到决定前坐在一起的众人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: someone holding a map open, asking a stranger the way.
core.cn: 核心意象：有人摊开地图，向陌生人问路。

branches.en: The first sense is a question handed to someone who knows more.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是把问题交给懂得更多的人。

branches.en: The second sense asks a page instead of a person.
branches.cn: 第二个义项问的是一页纸，而不是一个人。

branches.en: The third sense puts several voices around one table.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把几个声音放到同一张桌子旁。

branches.en: Both senses go looking for knowledge outside the self.
branches.cn: 两个义项都是到自己之外去寻找知识。

branches.en: Advice and discussion both end in a better informed choice.
branches.cn: 请教与商议都以更知情的选择收尾。

intro.en: Consult is built on Latin con-, together, plus consulere, to gather and deliberate.
intro.cn: consult 由拉丁语 con-（一起）与 consulere（聚集商议）构成。

definition_en: an expert who gives professional advice, or a senior doctor in a hospital
core_image: 一位夹着文件夹的人，在会议桌边为客户圈出重点
scene: 医院里，主治医生请来一位专科同行一起看片子。The consultant reviewed the scan before the operation.
sceneCN: 这里 consultant 指「会诊医生」（第 2 个义项：医院里的高级专科医生）；句意是这位会诊医生在手术前看了片子。

pos.zh: 顾问；会诊医生；专科医生

senses.title: A paid expert
senses.definition: a person paid to give expert advice in a field
senses.definitionCN: 受雇在某一领域提供专业意见的人
senses.example: The firm hired a safety consultant.
senses.exampleCN: 公司聘请了一位安全顾问。
senses.why: Experience becomes useful to others when it is lent out.
senses.whyCN: 经验被借出去，才对别人有用。

senses.title: A senior doctor
senses.definition: a senior hospital doctor who is a specialist in one area
senses.definitionCN: 医院里某一领域的高级专科医生
senses.example: The consultant explained the scan results.
senses.exampleCN: 这位专科医生解释了片子结果。
senses.why: In a hospital, the one who is consulted is the one who knows most.
senses.whyCN: 在医院里，被请教的人就是懂得最多的人。

intro.en: Consultant comes from the Latin verb consultare, to take counsel, plus the person ending -ant.
intro.cn: consultant 来自拉丁语动词 consultare（商议），加上表示人的词尾 -ant。

items.en: Consulere meant to gather people and deliberate.
items.cn: consulere 意为聚集众人商议。

items.en: Consultare named the repeated asking of counsel.
items.cn: consultare 指反复征询意见。

items.en: The ending -ant marked the person doing the act.
items.cn: 词尾 -ant 标记执行该行为的人。

items.en: English consultant first meant a person asked for advice.
items.cn: 英语 consultant 最初指被请教的人。

items.en: The word became a paid professional title.
items.cn: 这个词成为带薪的职业头衔。

items.en: British hospitals use it for a senior specialist.
items.cn: 英国医院用它指高级专科医生。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the consult- family, and the meaning group names other people who supply expert knowledge.

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a folder carried into a meeting, then move to the hospital room where the senior doctor is called in.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从被带进会议的文件夹开始，再到高级医生被请进的那间病房。

normal.en: Con- is together and sult is gather, so a consultant is the one others gather around to ask.

normal.en: A consultant is borrowed experience with a bill attached.
normal.cn: 顾问是借来的经验，附带着账单。

normal.en: In a British hospital, the consultant is the one others call.
normal.cn: 在英国医院里，顾问就是别人会去请的那位。

normal.en: The title means asked, not obeyed.
normal.cn: 这个头衔的意思是「被请教」，而不是「被服从」。

normal.en: A good consultant leaves the client smarter, not dependent.
normal.cn: 好的顾问让客户变聪明，而不是变依赖。

abstract.en: Picture a chair pulled up beside a client's desk.

examples.cn: 他们请来一位顾问审查这个方案。

examples.en: The consultant recommended a cheaper system.
examples.cn: 顾问推荐了一套更便宜的系统。

examples.en: Her father is a consultant at the city hospital.
examples.cn: 她父亲是市医院的专科医生。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 consultant 记成 consult（请教）加 ant（人）：总是被人请教的那个人，就是顾问。

root: 源自拉丁语 consultare（反复商议）加人称词尾 -ant，本义是被请教的人，后指收费提供专业意见的顾问与医院高级专科医生。

sensesIntro.en: From the expert a company borrows, to the senior doctor a ward calls in.
sensesIntro.cn: 从公司借来的那位专家，到病房里被请来的那位高级医生。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person with a folder, circling the key line for a client.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个夹着文件夹的人，为客户圈出关键的一行。

branches.en: The first sense is an expert whose time is bought.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是时间被购买的那位专家。

branches.en: The second sense is the same respect inside a hospital.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是同一份敬意落在医院里。

branches.en: Both senses name someone others turn to when the case is hard.
branches.cn: 两个义项都指情况棘手时别人会去找的人。

branches.en: A consultant is judged by whether the advice holds up later.
branches.cn: 顾问的好坏，要看建议日后是否站得住。

branches.en: In the ward, the title also carries the weight of a final word.
branches.cn: 在病房里，这个头衔还带着最终判断的分量。

definition_en: to use up a resource, to eat or drink something, or to destroy something completely
core_image: 一张嘴把整盘食物吃空，盘子见了底
scene: 夏天的老空调整天开着，电表转得飞快。Big cars consume far more fuel than small ones.
sceneCN: 这里 consume 指「消耗」（第 1 个义项：用掉资源或能量）；句意是大车比小车耗油多得多。

senses.title: Use up a resource
senses.definition: to use up energy, fuel or materials over time
senses.definitionCN: 在一段时间里用掉能量、燃料或材料
senses.example: Old machines consume too much electricity.
senses.exampleCN: 旧机器耗电太多。
senses.why: A resource is only noticed on the day it runs out.
senses.whyCN: 资源往往在耗尽那天才被人注意。

senses.title: Eat or drink
senses.definition: to eat or drink something until it is gone
senses.definitionCN: 把食物或饮料吃到、喝到不剩
senses.example: The guests consumed every dish on the table.
senses.exampleCN: 客人们把桌上的菜吃得精光。
senses.why: A meal is also a small act of using something up.
senses.whyCN: 一顿饭也是一次小小的用尽。

senses.title: Swallow up completely
senses.definition: to destroy something completely, especially by fire
senses.definitionCN: 彻底毁掉某物，尤指被火吞没
senses.example: The fire consumed the whole warehouse in minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 大火在几分钟内吞没了整座仓库。
senses.why: Fire takes without leaving anything on the plate.
senses.whyCN: 火拿走一切，盘子里什么也不剩。

intro.en: Consume comes from Latin consumere, to use up, built from com-, completely, and sumere, to take up.
intro.cn: consume 来自拉丁语 consumere，意为用尽，由 com-（彻底）与 sumere（拿取）构成。

items.en: Sumere meant to take up or take to oneself.
items.cn: sumere 意为拿起或取为己用。

items.en: Consumere meant to take up completely and so use up.
items.cn: consumere 意为彻底取走，因而用尽。

items.en: It also described fire taking a whole building.
items.cn: 它也描述火吞掉整座建筑。

items.en: French consumer kept the using and the destroying senses.
items.cn: 法语 consumer 同时保留耗用与毁掉两层意思。

items.en: English consume first meant to destroy or use up.
items.cn: 英语 consume 最初指毁掉或用尽。

items.en: It now commonly describes fuel, food and time.
items.cn: 如今它常用来描述燃料、食物与时间。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin take base sum-, and the meaning group names other verbs for using something up.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语拿取词基 sum-，近义组列出其他表示用尽的动词。

entries.definition: a person who buys goods or services
the act of using up fuel, food or time
to take something as true without proof
to put something to a purpose
to eat something very quickly or greedily
to use something until nothing is left

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from an empty plate, then move to a meter spinning fast and to a fire that leaves nothing.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一只空盘子开始，再到飞快转动的电表，最后到什么也不留的火。

normal.en: Con- is completely and sume is take, so consume is to take something completely away.
normal.cn: con- 是彻底，sume 是拿，consume 就是把东西彻底拿走。

normal.en: An empty plate is the clearest picture of consume.
normal.cn: 一只空盘子，是 consume 最清楚的画面。

normal.en: The meter spins because the machine consumes.
normal.cn: 电表飞转，是因为机器在消耗。

normal.en: Fire consumes; dinner consumes; a long meeting consumes your afternoon.
normal.cn: 火在吞噬，晚饭在被吃光，长会也在耗掉你的下午。

normal.en: What is consumed cannot be handed on.
normal.cn: 被消耗掉的东西，无法再交到别人手里。

abstract.en: Picture a fork scraping the last of a sauce.
abstract.cn: 想象一把叉子刮着盘底最后一点酱。

abstract.en: Picture a fuel gauge dropping toward empty.
abstract.cn: 想象油表向空位滑落。

abstract.en: Picture flame moving along a dry beam.
abstract.cn: 想象火焰顺着干燥的横梁蔓延。

examples.en: This heater consumes less power than the old one.
examples.cn: 这台取暖器比旧的省电。

examples.en: We consumed three pots of tea during the talk.
examples.cn: 谈话期间我们喝光了三壶茶。

examples.en: The flames consumed the dry grass in seconds.
examples.cn: 火焰几秒钟就吞没了干草。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 consume 记成 con（彻底）加 sume（拿取）：把东西彻底拿去用光，就是消耗、吃光。

root: 源自拉丁语 consumere（com 彻底 + sumere 拿取），本义是彻底取走，后指消耗资源、吃喝干净与吞噬烧毁。

sensesIntro.en: From fuel drained by a machine, to a table cleared by guests, and at last to a building swallowed by flame.
sensesIntro.cn: 从被机器耗掉的燃料，到被客人吃空的餐桌，最后到被火焰吞掉的建筑。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a plate scraped clean and a fuel gauge on empty.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只刮得干干净净的盘子，和一根见底的油表。

branches.en: The first sense is a slow drain that a meter can measure.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是电表能测出的缓慢流失。

branches.en: The second sense is eating and drinking until the dish is bare.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是吃到喝到盘碗空空。

branches.en: The third sense is destruction that leaves no remainder.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是不留残余的毁灭。

branches.en: Both senses turn something full into something less.
branches.cn: 两个义项都把满的东西变成更少的东西。

branches.en: Eating and burning are the same taking, only at different speeds.
branches.cn: 吃与烧是同一种拿取，只是速度不同。

intro.en: Consume is built on Latin com-, completely, plus sumere, to take up.

senses.title: A user of a service

definition_en: the act of using up fuel, food, energy or time, or the amount that is used

senses.title: Buying and using
senses.definition: the economic activity of buying and using goods and services
senses.definitionCN: 购买并使用商品与服务的经济活动

senses.exampleCN: 家庭消费支撑着经济的一半。

senses.whyCN: 经济是一个圆圈，花销让它转起来。

senses.example: In the last century, consumption was often fatal.
senses.exampleCN: 在上个世纪，痨病常常致命。
senses.why: A disease that consumes the body borrowed the same word.
senses.whyCN: 一种把身体耗掉的病，借用了同一个词。

items.en: French consumption carried both the spending and the illness senses.
items.cn: 法语中的这个词同时带有耗费与疾病两层意思。

definition_en: the state of touching, communication with someone, or a person you can reach
core_image: 两只手在桌面上握到一起
scene: 飞机落地后，她第一时间给家里发了消息。Please contact me when you arrive.
sceneCN: 这里 contact 指「联系」（第 1 个义项：与人取得沟通）；句意是你到了以后请与我联系。

senses.title: Getting in touch
senses.definition: the act of communicating with someone by message, call or meeting
senses.definitionCN: 通过消息、电话或见面与人沟通的行为
senses.example: We kept in contact after the course ended.
senses.exampleCN: 课程结束后我们仍保持联系。
senses.why: Two people can touch across a city with one short message.
senses.whyCN: 两个人靠一条短信，就能跨过一座城相触。

senses.title: Physical touching
senses.definition: the state of two things or surfaces being in touch
senses.definitionCN: 两个物体或表面相互挨着的状态
senses.example: Wash your hands after contact with the soil.
senses.exampleCN: 接触土壤后要洗手。
senses.why: The oldest sense is still the simplest: two surfaces meet.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项仍然最简单：两个表面碰上了。

senses.title: A person to reach
senses.definition: a person you know who can give help or information
senses.definitionCN: 能提供帮助或信息的熟人
senses.example: She has a contact inside the ministry.
senses.exampleCN: 她在部里有一个联络人。
senses.why: A useful name in a notebook is a door that opens later.
senses.whyCN: 笔记本里一个有用的名字，是日后会打开的门。

definition_en: to have something inside, or to keep something under control
core_image: 一只箱子把里面的东西全兜住，一点不外漏
scene: 她打开信封，里面是一张折好的地图。This box contains all the old letters.
sceneCN: 这里 contain 指「装有、包含」（第 1 个义项：内部盛有某物）；句意是这只箱子里装着所有旧信件。

senses.title: Have inside
senses.definition: to have something inside or as a part
senses.definitionCN: 内部盛有某物，或把某物作为一部分
senses.example: The letter contains a short apology.
senses.exampleCN: 这封信里有一句简短的道歉。
senses.why: A shell is interesting mainly for what it keeps.
senses.whyCN: 一个外壳之所以值得一提，主要看它装着什么。

senses.title: Have room for
senses.definition: to be able to hold a certain amount
senses.definitionCN: 能够装下一定的数量
senses.example: This bottle contains two litres.
senses.exampleCN: 这个瓶子能装两升。
senses.why: Every container has a limit it never tells you out loud.
senses.whyCN: 每个容器都有一个它不会开口说的限度。

senses.title: Keep under control
senses.definition: to stop something from spreading or showing
senses.definitionCN: 阻止某事物扩散或显露出来
senses.example: Firefighters contained the fire before midnight.
senses.exampleCN: 消防员在午夜前控制住了火势。
senses.why: The same word that holds water can hold back fear.
senses.whyCN: 兜住水的那同一个词，也能兜住恐惧。

intro.en: Contain comes from Latin continere, to hold together, built from com-, together, and tenere, to hold.
intro.cn: contain 来自拉丁语 continere，意为握在一起，由 com-（一起）与 tenere（握住）构成。

items.en: Tenere meant to hold in the hand or keep.
items.cn: tenere 意为握在手中或守住。

items.en: Continere meant to hold things together inside.
items.cn: continere 意为把东西拢在里面。

items.en: It also meant to keep feelings or crowds in check.
items.cn: 它也指把情绪或人群约束住。

items.en: French contenir carried the holding sense into use.
items.cn: 法语 contenir 把盛装的含义带入使用。

items.en: English contain first meant to hold within limits.
items.cn: 英语 contain 最初指在界限内盛住。

items.en: It now covers both holding things and holding back danger.
items.cn: 如今它既指盛装物品，也指遏制危险。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin hold base ten-, and the meaning group names other verbs for having something inside.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语握持词基 ten-，近义组列出其他表示内部含有的动词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a closed box, then move to a bottle with a fixed limit and to a fire held inside a line.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一只合上的箱子开始，再到一个有固定容量的瓶子，最后到被拦在一条线里的火。

normal.en: Con- is together and tain is hold, so contain is holding things together inside.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，tain 是握住，contain 就是把东西拢在里面。

normal.en: A box contains, a bottle contains, a good speaker contains nerves.
normal.cn: 箱子装着东西，瓶子装着水，好的演讲者装着紧张。

normal.en: Contain is a wall; include is a welcome.
normal.cn: contain 是一道墙，include 是一声欢迎。

normal.en: The lid is closed, and the story stays inside.
normal.cn: 盖子合上，故事就留在里面。

normal.en: To contain a fire is to give it nowhere to go.
normal.cn: 控制一场火，就是让它无处可去。

abstract.en: Picture a closed tin on a high shelf.
abstract.cn: 想象高处架子上的一只合上的铁盒。

abstract.en: Picture a jar filled exactly to the line.
abstract.cn: 想象一只刚好装到刻线的罐子。

abstract.en: Picture a rope line stopping a crowd.
abstract.cn: 想象一条绳线拦住人群。

examples.en: The report contains several useful charts.
examples.cn: 这份报告里有几张有用的图表。

examples.en: This drink contains no sugar at all.
examples.cn: 这种饮料完全不含糖。

examples.en: Doctors worked fast to contain the infection.
examples.cn: 医生迅速行动以控制感染。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 contain 记成 con（一起）加 tain（握住）：把东西一起握在壳里，就是包含、容纳。

root: 源自拉丁语 continere（com 一起 + tenere 握住），本义是把东西拢在一起，后指包含、容纳与把危险或情绪控制住。

sensesIntro.en: From what a box keeps inside, to the amount a bottle can hold, and to a fire stopped at a line.
sensesIntro.cn: 从箱子里装着的东西，到瓶子能装的量，最后到被拦在一条线上的火。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a closed box with everything held inside its walls.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只合上的箱子，东西都被兜在四壁之内。

branches.en: The first sense is simply what the walls enclose.
branches.cn: 第一个义项就是四壁围住的东西。

branches.en: The second sense is the size of the space inside.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是内部空间的大小。

branches.en: The third sense keeps something from getting out.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是让某物跑不出去。

branches.en: Both senses are about an inside that has a limit.
branches.cn: 两个义项都关于一个有界限的内部。

branches.en: A space with limits can also limit a danger.
branches.cn: 有界限的空间，也能限制危险。

intro.cn: contain 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 tenere（握住）构成。

latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的握持词基 ten-/tain- 也出现在 maintain、obtain 与 retain 中。

definition_en: a box, bottle or other object made to hold things
core_image: 码头上一排巨大的彩色集装箱
scene: 码头上，吊机把一只铁箱从船上吊到卡车。The container was loaded with clothes.

senses.title: A holder for things
senses.definition: a box, jar or bottle used to hold food or objects
senses.definitionCN: 用来盛放食物或物品的盒、罐或瓶
senses.example: Keep the flour in a dry container.
senses.exampleCN: 把面粉放在干燥的容器里。
senses.why: Small loose things need one shell to become a load.
senses.whyCN: 零散的小东西需要一个外壳，才能变成一批货。

senses.title: A giant steel box
senses.definition: a very large metal box used for moving goods by ship or train

senses.example: The container left the port at dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 那只集装箱在黎明时驶离港口。
senses.why: Standard sizes turned loading into a game of blocks.
senses.whyCN: 统一的尺寸，把装货变成了一场积木游戏。

intro.cn: container 是 contain 加表物的词尾 -er，源自拉丁语 continere（握在一起）。

items.en: English container first meant any vessel or holder.

items.en: It now means both a kitchen jar and a cargo box.
items.cn: 如今它既指厨房的罐子，也指货运的箱子。

definition_zh: 污染物；沾染物；使某物变得不纯或不宜使用的物质
definition_en: a substance that makes something impure, unsafe or unfit for its intended use by being present in it
core_image: 取样瓶里浮着一层薄薄的油膜，原本清澈的水面被这一点外来物搅得不再可信
scene: 检测员在水厂的取样瓶里发现一层薄薄的油膜，仪器读数随即报警。A single contaminant in the sample pushed the reading past the safety limit.
sceneCN: 这里 contaminant 指「混入某物、使其不纯或不宜使用的物质」（第 1 个义项：外来的沾染物使整体失去纯净）；句意为样本中一种污染物就把读数推过了安全限值。图中可辨识物件：取样瓶、油膜、检测仪、报警灯。

pos.zh: 污染物；沾染物（可数，指一种具体的污染物质）

senses.title: A substance that makes something impure
senses.titleCN: 使某物变得不纯的外来物质
senses.definition: any substance whose presence spoils the purity or quality of a material, medium or product
senses.definitionCN: 任何因其存在而破坏材料、介质或产品纯度与品质的物质
senses.example: A single contaminant in the sample pushed the reading past the safety limit.
senses.exampleCN: 样本中一种污染物就把读数推过了安全限值。
senses.why: The Latin root means 'to touch together', so a contaminant is literally something that has touched a clean body and left itself behind in it.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根意为「接触在一起」，因此 contaminant 字面上就是「碰过洁净之物并在其中留下自己的东西」。

senses.title: A pollutant in air, water or soil
senses.titleCN: 空气、水体或土壤中的污染物质
senses.definition: a substance present in an environmental medium at a level that harms organisms or uses
senses.definitionCN: 存在于环境介质中、其含量足以危害生物或用途的物质
senses.example: The aquifer held a solvent contaminant from the old factory.
senses.exampleCN: 含水层里存着老工厂留下的一种溶剂污染物。
senses.why: Environmental science adopted the word because it names the thing rather than the harm, which is measured separately.
senses.whyCN: 环境科学采用这个词，因为它命名的是物质本身，而危害另有指标衡量。

senses.title: A biological contaminant such as a microbe
senses.titleCN: 微生物等生物性沾染物
senses.definition: a bacterium, virus, fungus or other organism that makes a product or surface unsafe
senses.definitionCN: 使产品或表面变得不安全的细菌、病毒、真菌或其他生物
senses.example: A bacterial contaminant closed the production line for a week.
senses.exampleCN: 一种细菌污染物让生产线停了一周。
senses.why: Living things contaminate as effectively as chemicals, and laboratories needed one word that covers both.
senses.whyCN: 活物与化学品一样能造成沾染，实验室需要一个词同时涵盖两者。

senses.title: A trace residue of chemicals
senses.definition: a pesticide, drug, heavy metal or solvent left at very low concentration in food, water or tissue
senses.definitionCN: 以极低浓度残留在食品、水或组织中的农药、药物、重金属或溶剂
senses.example: Regulators set a limit for each pesticide contaminant.
senses.exampleCN: 监管机构为每种农药残留设定了限值。
senses.why: Modern instruments can find a few parts per billion, so the word now covers amounts far too small to see.
senses.whyCN: 现代仪器能检出十亿分之几，这个词于是涵盖了肉眼完全看不见的量。

senses.title: Foreign matter in food or medicine
senses.titleCN: 食品与药品中的外来异物
senses.definition: glass, metal, plastic or other matter that enters a product during handling and makes it unsafe
senses.definitionCN: 在加工过程中进入产品、使其不安全的玻璃、金属、塑料或其他物质
senses.example: A metal contaminant triggered the recall of the batch.
senses.exampleCN: 一种金属污染物触发了这批产品的召回。
senses.why: For manufacturers the word covers anything that should not be in the package, living or not.
senses.whyCN: 对制造商而言，这个词涵盖一切不该出现在包装里的东西，无论是否有生命。

senses.title: A radioactive contaminant
senses.definition: a radionuclide deposited on a surface, in soil or in a body where it does not belong
senses.definitionCN: 沉积在不该出现的表面、土壤或人体内的放射性核素
senses.example: Workers mapped the radioactive contaminant around the old reactor.
senses.exampleCN: 工作人员标出了旧反应堆周围的放射性污染物。
senses.why: Radiation is invisible and persistent, so the word stresses location and unwanted presence rather than visible dirt.
senses.whyCN: 辐射看不见又持久，这个词于是强调位置与「不该在此」，而非看得见的脏污。

senses.title: A particle in a cleanroom or vacuum
senses.titleCN: 洁净室或真空中的微粒沾染物
senses.definition: a dust particle, fibre or molecular film that ruins a wafer, lens or vacuum process
senses.definitionCN: 使晶圆、镜片或真空工艺失效的尘粒、纤维或分子膜
senses.example: A sub-micron contaminant ruined the coating on the lens.
senses.exampleCN: 一粒亚微米级污染物毁掉了镜片镀膜。
senses.why: In manufacturing the threshold is not health but function: a particle too small to see can still break a circuit.
senses.whyCN: 在制造中，门槛不是健康而是功能：小到看不见的颗粒仍能毁掉电路。

senses.title: Abstract: anything that corrupts a clean system
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：任何使洁净系统失真的东西
senses.definition: a transferred use for an element that corrupts the purity of data, language or a process
senses.definitionCN: 转指使数据、语言或流程丧失纯净性的因素
senses.example: A stale record is a contaminant in the training set.
senses.exampleCN: 过时记录是训练集里的一种污染。
senses.why: The metaphor works because the physical image is general: a small foreign thing enters a clean body and changes what the body can be used for.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻成立，是因为物理意象很通用：一小点外来物进入洁净的整体，改变了这个整体还能做什么。

intro.en: Contaminant is the noun use of the present participle of contaminate, which came to English from Latin by way of French. The root image is touching. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: contaminant 是 contaminate 现在分词的名词化用法，而 contaminate 经法语来自拉丁语。其词根意象是「接触」。年代均为约数。

items.en: Tangere meant 'to touch'. Its deeper origin is not established; the Indo-European root often proposed for it is a reconstruction rather than a recorded form.
items.cn: tangere 意为「触摸」。其更深来源未得到证明；常为它提出的印欧词根是重构，而非有记录的形式。

items.en: Com- 'together' plus the touch root produced contamen 'contact, pollution', the idea of one thing being defiled by touching another.
items.cn: com-「共同」加「触摸」词根构成 contamen「接触、污染」，即一物因碰到另一物而被弄脏。

items.en: Contaminare meant 'to defile by contact, to corrupt'. It carried both the physical and the moral sense of making something unclean.
items.cn: contaminare 意为「因接触而弄脏、败坏」。它同时带有「使不洁」的物理义与道德义。

items.en: English contaminate appears in the sixteenth century, first of moral or ritual defilement and later of physical mixture.
items.cn: 英语 contaminate 出现于十六世纪，先指道德或仪式上的玷污，后指物理上的混入。

items.en: Contaminant became a separate noun in modern technical English, once laboratories needed a word for the offending substance itself rather than the act.
items.cn: 当实验室需要一个词来指「肇事的物质本身」而非动作时，contaminant 在现代技术英语中成为独立名词。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date of the noun, deeper origin of tangere): the noun's first technical citation is not fixed, so its date is approximate; the pre-Latin origin of tangere is unsettled and any form offered for it is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（该名词的首见年代、tangere 的更深词源）：这个名词最早的 technical 书证没有定论，年代只能约计；tangere 在拉丁语之前的来源无定论，凡为其提出的形式均属重构。

note.en: Group one holds forms of the same touch-root family that are easily mistaken for the noun; group two holds other words for unwanted material, each with a different reason for being unwanted.
note.cn: 第一组是同出「触摸」词根、容易被误当作本名词的各种形式；第二组是其他表示「不该有的物质」的词，各自「不该有」的理由不同。

entries.definition: The act or result of contaminating; it names the event or condition, while contaminant names the substance.
entries.definitionCN: 污染的动作或结果；它指事件或状态，而 contaminant 指物质。

entries.definition: To make impure by contact; it is the action that puts a contaminant into something.
entries.definitionCN: 因接触而使不纯；它是把污染物放进某物的动作。

entries.definition: Touching or communication, from the same tangere root but with no sense of defilement.
entries.definitionCN: 接触或联系，同出 tangere 词根，但不含「玷污」之义。

entries.definition: Spread of disease by contact, from contingere 'to touch upon'; it shares the touch root but follows a medical path.
entries.definitionCN: 疾病经接触传播，出自 contingere「触及」；它与 contaminant 同享触摸词根，却走的是医学路线。

entries.definition: A substance that harms the environment; a contaminant may be harmless in small amounts and still unfit a product.
entries.definitionCN: 危害环境的物质；污染物质量小时可能无害，却仍能使产品不合格。

entries.definition: Any foreign matter in a material, often harmless; it is a purity term rather than a safety term.
entries.definitionCN: 材料中混入的任何外来物，常为无害；它是纯度术语，而非安全术语。

entries.definition: A substance that is poisonous to living things; toxicity is its defining property, which a contaminant need not have.
entries.definitionCN: 对生物有毒的物质；毒性是它的定义属性，而污染物不一定有毒。

entries.definition: Something added to a product to cheapen or fake it; the motive is deception, not accidental mixture.
entries.definitionCN: 为降低成本或造假而加入产品的东西；其动机是欺骗，而非意外混入。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The root is tangere 'to touch': something touched the clean body and stayed in it.
normal.cn: 词根是 tangere「触摸」：某物碰过洁净之物并留在了里面。

normal.en: Contaminant is the thing, contamination is the process, contaminate is the act.
normal.cn: contaminant 是物，contamination 是过程，contaminate 是动作。

normal.en: The family runs contaminate, contamination, contaminated, decontaminate and contaminative.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 contaminate、contamination、contaminated、decontaminate 与 contaminative。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the field: chemical contaminant, biological contaminant, trace contaminant.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：化学污染物、生物污染物、痕量污染物。

normal.en: Contact and contagion share the touch root but carry no idea of impurity in the same way.
normal.cn: contact 与 contagion 共享触摸词根，但并不以同样的方式带有「不纯」之意。

abstract.en: Picture one drop of ink falling into a glass of clear water.
abstract.cn: 想象一滴墨落进一杯清水。

abstract.en: Picture a single wrong figure entering an otherwise clean ledger.
abstract.cn: 想象一个错数进入一本本来干净的账。

abstract.en: Picture a rumour passing through a room and changing what everyone repeats.
abstract.cn: 想象一则传言穿过一间屋子，改变了每个人复述的内容。

examples.en: The filter removes the contaminant before the water reaches the tap.
examples.cn: 过滤器在水到达龙头之前去除污染物。

examples.en: Each contaminant has its own detection limit and removal method.
examples.cn: 每种污染物都有自己的检出限与去除方法。

examples.en: A biological contaminant can multiply after it enters the product.
examples.cn: 生物污染物进入产品之后还可能增殖。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「con（共同）+ tamin（接触）+ ant」——碰到干净东西、把它弄脏的那一位 → 污染物

root: 拉丁 contaminare「弄脏、败坏」< contamen「接触、污染」= com-（共同）+ tangere「触摸」；tangere 的更深来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one intrusion: a foreign thing touches a clean body, purity is lost, fitness is lost, the intruder is measured, and finally the same shape is used for corrupted data.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一次侵入展开：外来物碰触洁净体，纯净性失去，可用性失去，侵入者被计量，最后同一形态被用于被污染的数据。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one drop of oil floating in a bottle of clear water.
core.cn: 核心意象：一瓶清水里浮着一滴油。

branches.en: PURITY AND ENVIRONMENT: the general definition and the environmental case both name the intruder, not the harm.
branches.cn: 纯净与环境：总定义与环境情形命名的都是侵入者，而非危害。

branches.en: LIVING AND TRACE: a microbe and a residue are both small enough to escape the eye.
branches.cn: 活物与痕量：微生物与残留都小到肉眼难辨。

branches.en: PRODUCT SAFETY: what should never be in the package defines this sense.
branches.cn: 产品安全：本不该出现在包装里的东西，界定了这个义项。

branches.en: LOCATION AND FUNCTION: radiation in the wrong place and a particle in a cleanroom both ruin by being where they are.
branches.cn: 位置与功能：错处的辐射与洁净室里的颗粒，都因「待在那里」而毁事。

branches.en: TRANSFER: a bad record contaminates a dataset as oil contaminates water.
branches.cn: 转移：坏记录污染数据集，正如油污染水。

intro.en: Contaminant is a Latin-derived noun with a prefix, a touch root and a participial suffix, so it can be read morpheme by morpheme.
intro.cn: contaminant 是拉丁来源名词，含前缀、触摸词根与分词后缀，可以逐语素读出。

latinIntro.en: Latin tangere 'to touch' gives contact, contagion, contiguous and tangible; con- adds 'together' and -ant marks the thing that does the action.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 tangere「触摸」衍生 contact、contagion、contiguous 与 tangible；con- 添「共同」，-ant 标出执行动作之物。

items.example: The prefix marks contact between two things.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀标出两物之间的接触。

items.example: The root carries the idea of contact.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根带着「接触」的意思。

items.example: Contamen named the defilement left by touch.
items.exampleCN: contamen 指接触留下的污损。

items.example: The verb entered English as contaminate.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词以 contaminate 进入英语。

items.meaning: the thing or person that does
items.example: The suffix makes the verb into the offending thing.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把动词变成「肇事的物」。

items.example: One contaminant spoiled the whole tank.
items.exampleCN: 一种污染物毁掉了整罐。

items.meaning: the act or state of being defiled

items.exampleCN: 队伍对场地进行了去污。

items.example: The two surfaces were in contact.

definition_zh: 污染；玷污；使（样品、食品、环境）混入有害物
definition_en: to introduce a harmful or unwanted substance into something that was clean or pure
core_image: 一滴墨落进清水，整缸水从中心向外染成灰色
scene: 工厂把清洗溶剂的废水直接排进河里，下游的取水口被迫关闭。Waste solvent from the factory contaminated the river downstream.
sceneCN: 这里指有害物质进入水体使其不再洁净（第 1 个义项：把有害物排入水体、土壤或空气）；句意：工厂排出的废溶剂污染了下游的河水。

pos.zh: 污染；弄脏；使混入杂质；玷污

senses.title: To pollute water, soil or air
senses.definition: to put a harmful substance into the environment so that it is no longer safe
senses.definitionCN: 把有害物质排入环境，使其不再安全
senses.example: Waste solvent from the factory contaminated the river downstream.
senses.exampleCN: 工厂排出的废溶剂污染了下游的河水。
senses.why: The verb names the entry of foreign matter into something clean, and the environment is its largest stage.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词指异物进入原本洁净之物，环境是它最大的舞台。

senses.title: To infect food or a surface
senses.definition: to bring bacteria, viruses or other pathogens into food, water or a contact surface
senses.definitionCN: 把细菌、病毒或其他病原带入食物、饮水或接触表面
senses.example: Unwashed hands contaminated the sandwiches on the counter.
senses.exampleCN: 没洗的手污染了柜台上的三明治。
senses.why: Once the intruder is a living organism, contamination becomes infection, and the same verb covers it.
senses.whyCN: 一旦入侵者是活的生物体，污染就变成传染，同一个动词仍然管用。

senses.title: To spoil a scientific sample
senses.definition: to mix an unwanted substance into a sample so that a measurement no longer reflects the original
senses.definitionCN: 把不需要的物质混入样品，使测量结果不再反映原状
senses.example: A dirty pipette contaminated the blood sample.
senses.exampleCN: 一支不干净的吸管污染了血液样本。
senses.why: Laboratory work lives on purity, so the smallest intruder ruins the sample and the verb is used constantly.
senses.whyCN: 实验室工作依赖纯净，最小的入侵物就能毁掉样品，因此这个动词被频繁使用。

senses.title: To corrupt a language or culture
senses.definition: to mix foreign or inferior elements into a language, tradition or style until its character changes
senses.definitionCN: 把外来或低劣成分混入语言、传统或风格，使其性质改变
senses.example: Purists complained that slang contaminated the written language.
senses.exampleCN: 纯粹主义者抱怨俚语污染了书面语言。
senses.why: A language is imagined as a clear liquid, and borrowed elements as the drop of ink that darkens it.
senses.whyCN: 语言被想象成一缸清水，借入的成分则是把它染深的那滴墨。

senses.title: To pollute a dataset
senses.definition: to insert wrong, duplicated or irrelevant records into a dataset so that its results cannot be trusted
senses.definitionCN: 把错误、重复或无关的记录放进数据集，使结果不可信赖
senses.example: A faulty sensor contaminated the climate records for two years.
senses.exampleCN: 一个故障传感器污染了整整两年的气候记录。
senses.why: Data is treated like a sample: one bad entry spreads through every calculation made from it.
senses.whyCN: 数据被当作样品：一条坏记录会扩散到由它得出的每一次计算。

senses.title: To make something radioactive
senses.definition: to introduce radioactive material into an object, a place or a body
senses.definitionCN: 把放射性物质带入某件物体、某个场所或某个身体
senses.example: The accident contaminated the groundwater around the plant.
senses.exampleCN: 事故使电厂周围的地下水带上了放射性。
senses.why: Radiation is invisible and travels, so it became the most feared form of contamination.
senses.whyCN: 辐射看不见又会传播，因此成了最令人恐惧的污染形式。

senses.title: To taint a mind or morals
senses.definition: to fill a person or a group with ideas considered corrupting
senses.definitionCN: 用被认为败坏的观念充满某个人或某个群体
senses.example: The pamphlet warned that foreign films contaminated the young.
senses.exampleCN: 这本小册子警告说外国电影败坏了年轻人。
senses.why: The old religious sense of moral stain survived inside the modern word for physical pollution.
senses.whyCN: 古老的宗教性「道德污损」含义，保存在现代这个表示物质污染的词语里。

senses.title: To compromise a scene or evidence
senses.titleCN: 破坏现场或证据的纯净
senses.definition: to disturb a place or a piece of evidence so that traces are lost or no longer reliable
senses.definitionCN: 搅动现场或证据，使痕迹丢失或不再可靠
senses.example: Officers who walk through the room may contaminate the crime scene.
senses.exampleCN: 走进房间的警员可能破坏犯罪现场。
senses.why: Evidence must stay as it was found, so any added trace is contamination in the legal sense.
senses.whyCN: 证据必须保持发现时的样子，因此任何新增痕迹在法律意义上都是污染。

intro.en: Contaminate comes from a Latin verb of defilement built on a noun for the stain left by contact. The link to the Latin verb for touching is widely accepted, but the exact formation of the noun is still debated, so the deeper source is marked as unsettled.
intro.cn: 本词出自一个表示玷污的拉丁动词，其基础名词指接触留下的污损。它与拉丁语中表示触碰的动词有关，这一点被广泛接受，但那个名词的具体构成仍有争议，因此更早的来源标注为未有定论。

items.en: Tangere meant to touch, and the same root stands behind English words for contact and for contagion.
items.cn: 这个拉丁动词意为触碰，英语中表示接触与传染的词都出自同一词根。

items.en: Contamen named the defilement that contact leaves behind; its own formation and variant spellings are still discussed.
items.cn: 这个拉丁名词指接触留下的污损；它自身的构成与拼写变体至今仍有讨论。

items.en: The verb meant to defile or to make unclean, and early writers used it for religious and legal pollution.
items.cn: 这个动词意为玷污或使不洁，早期作者用它指宗教与法律意义上的污损。

items.en: English borrowed the verb in the sixteenth century, when the first sense was moral and religious rather than chemical.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪借入这个动词，当时最初的义项是道德与宗教性的，而不是化学性的。

items.en: Hygiene, chemistry and microbiology later moved the word to physical pollution of water, food and samples.
items.cn: 卫生学、化学与微生物学后来把这个词转向水、食品与样品的物质污染。

items.en: Source uncertain: the derivation of the noun for contact-stain from the verb for touching is the usual account, not a settled fact, so no single ancestral form is claimed.
items.cn: 来源不确定：把表示接触污损的名词追溯到表示触碰的动词，只是通行的解释，并非定论，因此不主张单一祖形。

note.en: The first group shares the contact root or looks close to it; the second group names ways of making something impure. Contaminate is about mixing in foreign matter, while distort is about twisting a shape or a story, and the two are not interchangeable.
note.cn: 第一组共享接触词根或字形相近；第二组是使某物不纯的各种方式。本词指混入异物，扭曲类词则指扭歪形状或歪曲叙述，两者不能互换。

entries.definition: The state or the act of being made impure.
entries.definitionCN: 被弄得不纯的状态或动作。

entries.definition: The intruding substance itself, not the act.
entries.definitionCN: 指入侵的物质本身，而不是动作。

entries.definition: Touching or communication; it keeps the literal sense of the root.
entries.definitionCN: 接触或联系；保留了词根的字面义。

entries.definition: The spread of disease by contact; it names transmission, not impurity.
entries.definitionCN: 疾病经接触传播；指传播，而非不纯。

entries.definition: To make the environment dirty, usually on a large scale; it is the public word for the same act.
entries.definitionCN: 使环境变脏，通常指大规模；是同一动作的公共说法。

entries.definition: To bring a pathogen into a body; it requires a living host.
entries.definitionCN: 把病原带入身体；需要有活的宿主。

entries.definition: To spoil something with a small amount of something bad, often figuratively.
entries.definitionCN: 用少量坏东西败坏某物，常用于比喻。

entries.definition: To put a toxic substance into something that will be eaten or drunk.
entries.definitionCN: 把有毒物质放进将被吃喝的东西。

entries.definition: To add an inferior substance to a product, usually for profit.
entries.definitionCN: 为获利在产品中掺入劣质成分。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the contact root, the real family and the laboratory phrases that show where the word lives.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用接触词根、真实同族词，以及能显示使用场合的实验室搭配。

normal.en: The root means to touch, and the noun inside the verb means the stain that touching leaves.
normal.cn: 词根意为触碰，动词内部的名词指触碰留下的污损。

normal.en: The family runs contamination, contaminant, contaminated and decontaminate.
normal.cn: 同族词有表示污染的名词、污染物、受污染的与去除污染。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark it: contaminate water, contaminate a sample, contaminated food.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出用法：污染水源、使样品受污染、受污染的食品。

normal.en: The laboratory is its home: one dirty pipette ruins a whole sample.
normal.cn: 实验室是它的主场：一支脏吸管毁掉整个样品。

normal.en: The opposite is built with a removal prefix: to decontaminate is to take the intrusion out.
normal.cn: 反义靠一个表示去除的前缀构成：去污就是把入侵物清走。

abstract.en: Picture one drop of ink falling into a glass of clear water.
abstract.cn: 想象一滴墨落进一杯清水。

abstract.en: Picture a footprint appearing on a page that was supposed to stay blank.
abstract.cn: 想象一页本该空白的纸上多出一个脚印。

abstract.en: Picture a rumour that enters a quiet town and colours every conversation.
abstract.cn: 想象一则传言进入平静的小镇，把每场谈话都染上颜色。

examples.en: Heavy metals contaminated the soil near the old factory.
examples.cn: 重金属污染了老厂附近的土壤。

examples.en: One careless handler can contaminate a whole batch of food.
examples.cn: 一个粗心的操作者就能污染整批食品。

examples.en: The virus contaminated the cell culture within days.
examples.cn: 病毒在几天之内就污染了这批细胞培养物。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「肯」加「摊」加「米内特」——脏东西摊进米里，整袋都不干净：污染

root: 拉丁语「触碰」词根衍生出表示接触污损的名词，再加动词词尾构成「玷污、使不洁」；名词的具体构成仍有争议，故更早来源存疑。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one movement: a harmful outsider enters something clean, whether river, food, sample, language, dataset, body, mind or evidence.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿着同一个动作：有害的外来者进入原本洁净之物，可以是河流、食品、样品、语言、数据集、身体、心灵或证据。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a drop of ink entering clear water and darkening the whole glass from the centre outward.
core.cn: 核心意象：一滴墨落进清水，整缸水从中心向外染成灰色。

branches.en: THE ENVIRONMENT: water, soil and air, including the invisible spread of radiation.
branches.cn: 环境：水、土壤与空气，也包括辐射那种看不见的扩散。

branches.en: THE BODY AND THE SCENE: pathogens in food, and a crime scene no longer clean.
branches.cn: 身体与现场：食品中的病原，以及不再洁净的犯罪现场。

branches.en: THE RECORD: a spoiled sample and a polluted dataset, where one intruder ruins every reading.
branches.cn: 记录：被毁的样品与被污染的数据集，一个入侵者毁掉所有读数。

branches.en: THE CULTURE: a language or tradition mixed with foreign elements until its character changes.
branches.cn: 文化：语言或传统混入外来成分，直到性质改变。

branches.en: THE MIND: morals imagined as a clear surface that can be stained.
branches.cn: 心灵：道德被想象成一块可以被染污的洁净表面。

intro.en: Contaminate is a Latin verb of touching and defilement; its family divides into the substance that intrudes and the act of removing it.
intro.cn: 本词是一个表示触碰与玷污的拉丁动词；其词族分为入侵的物质与去除污染的动作两支。

latinIntro.en: The Latin verb for touching and the noun for contact-stain are the two pieces behind the English word; the noun ending is Latin as well.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语中表示触碰的动词与表示接触污损的名词，是英语词背后的两个构件；名词词尾同样来自拉丁语。

items.example: It marks the meeting of two substances.
items.exampleCN: 它标记两种物质的相遇。

items.example: The root supplies the idea of contact.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根提供接触的观念。

items.example: The noun turns contact into a stain.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词把接触变成污损。

items.example: The verb is the direct source of the English word.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是英语词的直接来源。

items.example: It gives the Latin stem an English verb shape.
items.exampleCN: 它给拉丁词干披上英语动词外形。

items.example: It builds the name of the process.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示过程的名称。

items.meaning: the thing or person that does
items.example: It builds the name of the intruding substance.
items.exampleCN: 它构成入侵物质的名称。

items.example: It builds the verb for taking the intrusion out.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示清除入侵物的动词。

items.example: It marks the state of an object already made impure.
items.exampleCN: 它标记已被弄脏的对象状态。

definition_zh: 沉思；仔细考虑；打算；凝视
definition_en: to hold a subject in the mind for a long time, or to consider a possible action
core_image: 一个人站在划定的观象圈里，久久仰头看天，圈外的一切都被暂时隔开
scene: 棋手盯着棋盘，久久不动，把后面几步都在心里走了一遍。The old player contemplated his next three moves in silence.
sceneCN: 这里指长时间凝神思考、在心里反复推演（第 1 个义项：对某事长久而专注地思考）；句意：这位老棋手静静地沉思接下来三步棋。

senses.title: To think deeply about something
senses.titleCN: 对某事长久而专注地思考
senses.definition: to keep a subject in the mind over a stretch of time, turning it over from several sides
senses.definitionCN: 在一段时间内把某个主题留在心里，从多个方面反复打量
senses.example: The old player contemplated his next three moves in silence.
senses.exampleCN: 这位老棋手静静地沉思接下来三步棋。
senses.why: The Latin verb began as attentive watching inside a marked space, and watching turned inward becomes thinking.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁动词最初指在划定的空间里凝神观看，观看转向内心就成了思考。

senses.title: To consider doing something
senses.definition: to have a possible action in view, usually without having decided yet
senses.definitionCN: 把某个可能的行动放在眼前，通常尚未决定
senses.example: She is contemplating a move to another city.
senses.exampleCN: 她正在考虑搬到另一座城市。
senses.why: Once an action is held before the mind long enough to be weighed, the verb means to be thinking of doing it.
senses.whyCN: 一个行动在心头放得够久、被反复权衡，这个动词就表示打算去做。

senses.title: To gaze at something attentively
senses.definition: to look at something for a long time with full attention
senses.definitionCN: 长时间全神贯注地看某物
senses.example: He contemplated the painting without speaking for several minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 他盯着那幅画看了好几分钟，一句话也没说。
senses.why: The oldest sense is simply long looking; thought is described as a kind of inner gaze.
senses.whyCN: 最早的义项就是长久地看；思考被描述为一种内在的注视。

senses.title: To meditate on a sacred subject
senses.definition: in religious practice, to rest the mind on a holy truth or mystery
senses.definitionCN: 在宗教实践中，让心停留在神圣的真理或奥秘上
senses.example: The monks contemplate the mystery in silence each morning.
senses.exampleCN: 修士们每天清晨在静默中默观这一奥秘。
senses.why: Christian writers took the old verb of watching and made it the name of prayerful attention.
senses.whyCN: 基督教作者接过这个古老的观看动词，把它变成祈祷式专注之名。

senses.title: To live the contemplative life
senses.definition: to devote oneself to reflection rather than to action, as a way of life
senses.definitionCN: 把自身献给反思而非行动，作为一种生活方式
senses.example: Some traditions value the person who contemplates over the person who acts.
senses.exampleCN: 有些传统更看重沉思的人，而不是行动的人。
senses.why: When contemplation becomes a habit and a calling, the verb names a whole form of life.
senses.whyCN: 当沉思成为一种习惯与召唤，这个动词就指一整套生活方式。

senses.title: To weigh a choice before deciding
senses.definition: to compare the costs and benefits of an option before acting
senses.definitionCN: 在行动之前比较某个选项的代价与好处
senses.example: The board contemplated the merger for six months.
senses.exampleCN: 董事会对这桩合并权衡了半年。
senses.why: A choice held up and turned over in the mind is the practical form of long thought.
senses.whyCN: 把选择举起来在心里反复翻转，就是长久思考的实际形态。

senses.title: To envisage consequences
senses.definition: to think through what will follow from an action or a change
senses.definitionCN: 推想某个行动或变化会带来什么
senses.example: Before signing, he contemplated the effect on his family.
senses.exampleCN: 签字之前，他设想了这件事对家庭的影响。
senses.why: The verb looks forward as well as inward, since consequences are also something one can hold before the mind.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词既向内也向前，因为后果同样可以被摆在心头。

senses.title: Of a plan that allows for something
senses.titleCN: 方案预设、容许某种情况
senses.definition: of a plan or a rule, to have a case in view and to allow for it
senses.definitionCN: 指计划或规则已经把某种情况看在眼里并予以容许
senses.example: The agreement does not contemplate any further payment.
senses.exampleCN: 这份协议并未预设还要再付任何款项。
senses.why: Official and legal usage treats the plan itself as the one doing the thinking, which is the word's coldest extension.
senses.whyCN: 官方与法律用法把计划本身当作思考者，这是这个词最冷的一层延伸。

intro.en: Contemplate goes back to a Latin verb for watching attentively inside a space marked out for observation. The religious sense came first in English, and the everyday sense of considering an action followed.
intro.cn: 本词可追溯到拉丁语中表示在划定为观察用的空间内凝神观看的动词。英语中先出现宗教义，随后才有考虑某个行动的日常义。

items.en: Templum named a space marked out for observation and for taking auspices, and only later a temple.
items.cn: 这个拉丁名词指划出来供观察与占卜的空间，后来才指神庙。

items.en: The prefix com- meant together and marked a gathering of attention into one place.
items.cn: 前缀表示一起，标记注意力向一处集中。

items.en: The verb meant to observe within such a space, and so to give a thing one's full attention.
items.cn: 这个动词指在这样的空间里观察，因此指对某物投以全部注意力。

items.en: Christian writers used it for the prayerful attention that rests on a sacred truth.
items.cn: 基督教作者用它指停留在神圣真理上的祈祷式专注。

items.en: English borrowed it through French in the fourteenth century, first in religious prose.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪经法语借入，最早见于宗教文本。

items.en: The earlier origin of the Latin noun for the marked space is not settled, and this note concerns only that deeper layer, not the clear Latin-to-French-to-English chain.
items.cn: 拉丁语中那个表示划定空间的名词，其更早来源未有定论；这里只说明更早的一层，不涉及清楚的拉丁语经法语到英语的传递链。

note.en: The first group shares the marked-space root or its English descendants; the second group names neighbouring kinds of thinking and looking.
note.cn: 第一组共享划定空间的词根或其英语后裔；第二组是相邻的思考与观看类型。

entries.definition: The state or practice of long, quiet thought.
entries.definitionCN: 长久静思的状态或实践。

entries.definition: Given to reflection; it describes a person or a life.
entries.definitionCN: 耽于反思的；描述人或生活方式。

entries.definition: A building for worship, from the same word for a marked-out space.
entries.definitionCN: 供礼拜的建筑，出自同一个表示划定空间的名词。

entries.definition: A pattern to copy, which came through the idea of a marked or fitted piece.
entries.definitionCN: 供复制的样板，其来源经过「划好或配好的构件」这一层。

entries.definition: To weigh a question heavily; it stresses the weighing rather than the long looking.
entries.definitionCN: 反复掂量一个问题；强调权衡，而非长久观看。

entries.definition: To focus the mind, often on a spiritual subject; it is the technical word for the religious sense.
entries.definitionCN: 使心专注，常指神圣主题；是宗教义的技术说法。

entries.definition: To think in a loose, dreamy way; it lacks the deliberate attention of this word.
entries.definitionCN: 松散而梦幻地想；缺少本词那种有意的专注。

entries.definition: To take something into account before deciding; it is the plain word for sense two.
entries.definitionCN: 决定前把某事纳入考量；是第二个义项的平实说法。

entries.definition: To look long and steadily; it names the looking without the thinking.
entries.definitionCN: 长久而稳定地看；只说看，不带思考。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the marked-space root, the real family and the phrases of plans, religion and decision.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用划定空间的词根、真实同族词，以及计划、宗教与决策中的固定搭配。

normal.en: The root names a space marked out for watching, so the verb means attention held in one place.
normal.cn: 词根指为观看而划出的空间，因此动词指把注意力收在一处。

normal.en: The family runs contemplation, contemplative, contemplator and contemplatively.
normal.cn: 同族词有沉思、沉思的、沉思者与沉思地。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark it: contemplate a change, contemplate the future, contemplate doing something.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出用法：考虑改变、思量未来、考虑做某事。

normal.en: The religious sense is the older English one, and the plain sense of considering an action came later.
normal.cn: 宗教义是较早的英语用法，平实的考虑行动之义较晚出现。

normal.en: Official usage says a plan contemplates a case, which is the coldest but very common extension.
normal.cn: 官方用法说某方案预设某种情况，这是最冷门却极常见的延伸。

abstract.en: Picture a circle drawn on the floor, and everything outside it going quiet.
abstract.cn: 想象地上画了一个圈，圈外的一切都安静下来。

abstract.en: Picture a coin held up and turned over many times before it is spent.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚硬币被举起、翻转许多次，才决定花掉。

abstract.en: Picture a still pool that keeps a single image for hours.
abstract.cn: 想象一池静水，把同一个倒影留住好几个小时。

examples.en: She contemplated the offer for a week before answering.
examples.cn: 她考虑了一周才回复那个提议。

examples.en: He sat by the river and contemplated the water.
examples.cn: 他坐在河边，凝视着水面。

examples.en: The rules do not contemplate part-time workers.
examples.cn: 这些规则并未预设兼职员工的情况。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「肯」加「坦普」——在划好的空地里久久看天，心里反复想：沉思、考虑

root: 拉丁语「划定供观察的空间」一词加「一起」前缀，构成「在划定处凝神观看」，再经法语进入英语；先有宗教义，后扩展为考虑与打算。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses move from long attentive watching to deep thought, then to considering an action, weighing a choice, foreseeing results, and finally to a plan that allows for a case.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从长久的凝神观看，走向深度思考，再到考虑某个行动、权衡选择、预想后果，最后是方案预设某种情况。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person standing inside a circle marked on the ground, looking at the sky for a long time while everything outside the circle goes quiet.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人站在地上划出的圆圈里，久久仰头看天，圈外的一切都安静下来。

branches.en: THE GAZE AND THE THOUGHT: long looking without, and the same attention turned inward.
branches.cn: 观看与思考：向外的长久注视，以及转向内心的同一种专注。

branches.en: THE DECISION: an action held in view, and a choice weighed before it is made.
branches.cn: 抉择：把某个行动放在眼前，以及在做出之前的权衡。

branches.en: THE RELIGIOUS AND THE PHILOSOPHICAL: prayerful attention, and a whole life given to reflection.
branches.cn: 宗教与哲思：祈祷式的专注，以及献给反思的整个人生。

branches.en: THE FORESIGHT: consequences held before the mind before one acts.
branches.cn: 预见：行动之前把后果摆在心头。

branches.en: THE DOCUMENT: a plan or rule that has a case in view and allows for it.
branches.cn: 文件：把某种情况看在眼里并予以容许的计划或规则。

intro.en: Contemplate is a Latin verb of attentive watching, built from a prefix and a noun for a marked-out space; English added its endings and later widened the meaning.
intro.cn: 本词是一个表示凝神观看的拉丁动词，由前缀与表示划定空间的名词构成；英语加上词尾，后来又扩大了含义。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplies both the marked-space noun and the verb of watching; French supplies the form English borrowed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语同时提供表示划定空间的名词与表示观看的动词，法语提供英语借入的形式。

items.example: It gathers attention into one place.
items.exampleCN: 它把注意力收拢到一处。

items.meaning: a space marked out for observation
items.example: The noun supplies the setting of the gaze.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词提供注视的场所。

items.example: The verb is the direct ancestor of the English word.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是英语词的直接祖形。

items.example: The noun names the state the verb produces.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词指动词造成的状态。

items.example: It gives the Latin stem an English verb shape.
items.exampleCN: 它给拉丁词干披上英语动词外形。

items.example: It builds the English name for the practice.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示这种实践的英语名词。

items.example: It builds the adjective for a reflective person or life.
items.exampleCN: 它构成描述爱反思的人或生活的形容词。

items.example: It builds the rare name for the person who contemplates.
items.exampleCN: 它构成罕见的、指沉思者的名词。

items.example: It turns the adjective into an adverb of manner.
items.exampleCN: 它把形容词变成方式副词。

latinEntries.meaning: a space marked out for observation; a temple
latinEntries.meaningCN: 划出来供观察的空间；神庙

definition_zh: 当代的；同时代的；同时代的人
definition_en: belonging to the present time, or existing at the same time as something else
core_image: 一间摆着现代家具和旧木梁的屋子，两个时代并排
scene: 美术馆的一层正在展出当下艺术家的作品。The museum has a whole floor of contemporary art.
sceneCN: 这里 contemporary 指「当代的」（第 1 个义项：属于当下这个时代）；句意是这家美术馆有整整一层当代艺术。

senses.title: Of the present age
senses.definition: belonging to the time we live in now
senses.definitionCN: 属于我们现在生活的这个时代
senses.example: She collects contemporary paintings.
senses.exampleCN: 她收藏当代绘画。
senses.why: Every age calls itself the present, and means it.
senses.whyCN: 每个时代都把自己叫作当下，而且说得很真诚。

senses.title: Of the same time
senses.definition: existing or happening in the same period as something else
senses.definitionCN: 与另一事物存在于同一个时期
senses.example: These two buildings are contemporary with each other.
senses.exampleCN: 这两座建筑属于同一时代。
senses.why: Two things can share a century without ever meeting.
senses.whyCN: 两件事可以共处一个世纪，却从未相遇。

senses.title: A person of the same age
senses.definition: a person who lived or worked at the same time as another
senses.definitionCN: 与另一人同时生活或工作的人
senses.example: He was a contemporary of the young Mozart.
senses.exampleCN: 他是青年莫扎特的同时代人。
senses.why: History is easier to see beside someone who stood next to it.
senses.whyCN: 历史若挨着一个曾站在旁边的人来看，会清楚些。

intro.en: Contemporary comes from Latin contemporarius, built from com-, together, and tempus, time.
intro.cn: contemporary 来自拉丁语 contemporarius，由 com-（一起）与 tempus（时间）构成。

items.en: Tempus meant time or a period of time.
items.cn: tempus 意为时间或一段时期。

items.en: Contemporarius meant sharing the same time.
items.cn: contemporarius 意为共处同一时间。

items.en: It described events and people of one period.
items.cn: 它用来描述同一时期的事件与人物。

items.en: French contemporain carried both the present and the same-time senses.
items.cn: 法语 contemporain 同时带有当下与同时两层意思。

items.en: English contemporary first meant living at the same time.
items.cn: 英语 contemporary 最初指生活在同一时期。

items.en: It now usually points to art and culture of our own day.
items.cn: 如今它通常指我们这一天的艺术与文化。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin time base tempor-, and the meaning group names other words for what belongs to now.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语时间词基 tempor-，近义组列出其他表示「属于现在」的词。

entries.definition: lasting only for a short time
happening in the same period
the speed at which music is played
relating to the present or recent times
happening or existing now
existing at this moment

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a room where new chairs stand under old beams, then move to two lives sharing one century.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从新椅子摆在旧木梁下的房间开始，再到共享一个世纪的两个人。

normal.en: Con- is together and tempor is time, so contemporary is sharing one time.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，tempor 是时间，contemporary 就是共处同一时间。

normal.en: Contemporary art is the art of the room you are standing in.
normal.cn: 当代艺术，就是你此刻站着的那间屋子里的艺术。

normal.en: Two painters of one year are contemporaries, even if they never met.
normal.cn: 同一年份的两位画家就是同时代人，哪怕从未见过。

normal.en: Temporary lasts a while; contemporary means this while.
normal.cn: temporary 是持续一阵子，contemporary 指的是眼下这一阵。

normal.en: Every era thinks it is the final one.
normal.cn: 每个时代都以为自己是最后一个。

abstract.en: Picture old wooden beams above a clean new table.
abstract.cn: 想象旧木梁下面一张干净的新桌子。

abstract.en: Picture two calendars hanging side by side.
abstract.cn: 想象两本日历并排挂着。

abstract.en: Picture a gallery wall lit by a single lamp.
abstract.cn: 想象画廊的一面墙被一盏灯照亮。

examples.en: The gallery shows contemporary Chinese painting.
examples.cn: 这家画廊展出中国当代绘画。

examples.en: The poet was a contemporary of Shakespeare.
examples.cn: 这位诗人是莎士比亚的同时代人。

examples.en: Contemporary life moves faster than it did a century ago.
examples.cn: 当代生活比一个世纪前快得多。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 contemporary 记成 con（一起）加 tempor（时间）加 ary：和你共享同一段时间的，就是同时代的、当代的。

root: 源自拉丁语 contemporarius（com 一起 + tempus 时间），本义是共处同一时间，后指当代的、同时代的与同时代的人。

sensesIntro.en: From the art of our own day, to two lives in one century, and to the person who stood beside a famous name.
sensesIntro.cn: 从我们这一天的艺术，到同一个世纪里的两段人生，最后到站在名人身边的那个人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a modern chair standing under an old timber beam.
core.cn: 核心意象：一把现代椅子立在旧木梁之下。

branches.en: The first sense points at the culture being made right now.
branches.cn: 第一个义项指向此刻正在被创造的文化。

branches.en: The second sense lines two things up in one period.
branches.cn: 第二个义项把两件事排进同一个时期。

branches.en: The third sense turns the period into a person.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把一段时期变成一个人。

branches.en: Both senses depend on a clock everyone agrees about.
branches.cn: 两个义项都依赖一个人人都认的时钟。

branches.en: A contemporary is a witness who happened to share the years.
branches.cn: 同时代人就是一个恰好共享那些年份的见证者。

intro.en: Contemporary is built on Latin com-, together, plus tempus, time, with the ending -ary.
intro.cn: contemporary 由拉丁语 com-（一起）、tempus（时间）与词尾 -ary 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin time base tempor- also appears in temporary, tempo and temporal.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的时间词基 tempor- 也出现在 temporary、tempo 与 temporal 中。

items.exampleCN: 这两位作家是同时代人。
这两份记录属于同一时期。

items.meaning: in the manner of the present time
items.exampleCN: 这座大厅采用了当代风格。

items.meaning: the speed of a piece of music
items.example: The tempo slowed near the end.
items.exampleCN: 曲子在结尾处慢了下来。

items.meaning: relating to time or worldly life
items.meaningCN: 与时间或世俗生活有关的
items.example: The essay deals with temporal change.
items.exampleCN: 这篇文章讨论时间中的变化。

items.meaning: to delay in order to gain time
spoken without preparation, on the spot
items.meaningCN: 当场说出而未经准备的

definition_zh: n. 轻视，蔑视；藐视（法庭）
definition_en: a feeling that someone or something is worthless
core_image: 一个人把递来的东西看成尘土，不予接手
scene: 他带着轻蔑看了看那份报价。He looked at the offer with contempt.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：contempt 指轻蔑；句意是他带着轻蔑看那份报价。

senses.title: A low opinion
senses.definition: the feeling that someone deserves no respect
senses.definitionCN: 认为某人不配被尊重的感觉
senses.example: He looked at the offer with contempt.
senses.exampleCN: 他带着轻蔑看那份报价。
senses.why: Latin contemnere means to despise.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 contemnere 意为轻视。

senses.title: Disobedience to a court
senses.definition: the offence of disobeying a court
senses.definitionCN: 不服从法庭的违法行为
senses.example: He was charged with contempt of court.
senses.exampleCN: 他被控藐视法庭。
senses.why: The feeling becomes a legal offence.
senses.whyCN: 这种态度变成一项罪名。

intro.en: Contempt is Latin contemptus, a despising.
intro.cn: contempt 是拉丁语 contemptus，意为鄙视。

items.en: Temnere means to slight or scorn.
items.cn: temnere 意为轻视。

entries.definition: Showing scorn.
Worthy of contempt.
To consider deeply.
A strong feeling of no respect.
The feeling that something is beneath one.
A lack of proper respect.
Speech or action making fun of someone.

normalIntro.en: Contempt looks down and finds nothing worth lifting.
normalIntro.cn: contempt 低头一看，觉得没有东西值得拿起。

normal.en: Temnere means to slight.
normal.cn: temnere 意为轻视。

normal.en: Contemnere means to despise.
normal.cn: contemnere 意为蔑视。

normal.en: Contempt is that low opinion.
normal.cn: contempt 就是这种低看。

normal.en: To hold someone in contempt is to look down.
normal.cn: hold in contempt 即瞧不起。

normal.en: Contempt of court is a legal offence.
normal.cn: 藐视法庭是一项罪名。

abstract.en: Eyes travelling down and away.
abstract.cn: 向下移开的目光。

abstract.en: A hand refusing to reach out.
abstract.cn: 拒绝伸出的手。

abstract.en: A coin flicked off a table.
abstract.cn: 被弹下桌的一枚硬币。

examples.en: She spoke of the plan with contempt.
examples.cn: 她带着轻蔑谈起这个计划。

examples.en: His contempt for the rules was plain.
examples.cn: 他对规则的蔑视显而易见。

examples.en: The judge found him in contempt.
examples.cn: 法官裁定他藐视法庭。

dict_mnemonic.text: con（完全）+ tempt（轻视）→ 完全看轻，即蔑视。

root: 拉丁 con（完全）+ temnere（轻视）→ contemptus（蔑视）→ 英语 contempt

sensesIntro.en: A low view of someone, which can become a legal offence.
sensesIntro.cn: 对他人的低看，有时会构成一项罪名。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: eyes travelling down and away

branches.en: An offer waved away.
branches.cn: 被挥手撇开的一份报价。

branches.en: A name spoken with a sneer.
branches.cn: 带着冷笑说出的名字。

branches.en: A refusal to answer a court.
branches.cn: 拒不回应法庭。

branches.en: A charge read out in court.
branches.cn: 法庭上宣读的指控。

branches.en: Scorn held, or shown by refusal.
branches.cn: 藏在心里或表现为拒绝的蔑视。

intro.en: Contempt is the noun behind contemptuous and contemptible.
intro.cn: contempt 是 contemptuous 与 contemptible 背后的名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin temnere is to slight and contemnere is to despise.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 temnere 意为轻视，contemnere 意为蔑视。

definition_zh: v. 竞争，争夺；主张，坚称；应对，抗争
definition_en: to compete for something, or to argue that something is true
core_image: 两方各拉一端，绳子绷得笔直
scene: 十支队伍争夺同一个奖杯。Ten teams contend for the same cup.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：contend 指争夺；句意是十支队伍争夺同一个奖杯。

senses.title: Struggle for a prize
senses.definition: to compete with others for something
senses.definitionCN: 与他人争夺某物
senses.example: Ten teams contend for the cup.
senses.exampleCN: 十支队伍争夺奖杯。
senses.why: Latin contendere means to stretch with others.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 contendere 意为与他人一同用力。

senses.title: Argue as true
senses.definition: to state firmly that something is true
senses.definitionCN: 坚定地认为某事为真
senses.example: He contends that the rule is unfair.
senses.exampleCN: 他坚称这条规则不公。
senses.why: The tug of words replaces the tug of ropes.
senses.whyCN: 言语的拉扯取代了绳索的拉扯。

senses.title: Struggle against
senses.definition: to have to deal with a difficulty
senses.definitionCN: 不得不应付困难
senses.example: She had to contend with noise.
senses.exampleCN: 她不得不应付噪音。
senses.why: The contest turns into endurance.
senses.whyCN: 竞争变成了耐力。

intro.en: Contend is Latin contendere, to stretch with another.
intro.cn: contend 是拉丁语 contendere，意为与他人一同绷紧用力。

items.en: Tendere means to stretch.
items.cn: tendere 意为拉伸。

items.en: Contendere means to stretch with others.
items.cn: contendere 意为与他人一同用力。

items.en: Contentio names the struggle.
items.cn: contentio 指争斗。

items.en: English used contend of battle.
items.cn: 十五世纪英语用它指战斗。

items.en: Law used contend of arguing a case.
items.cn: 十七世纪法律用它指论辩案件。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the contend- stem; the near-meaning group names competing and arguing.
note.cn: 形近组共享 contend- 词干；近义组列出竞争与论辩。

entries.definition: An argument or claim.
Likely to cause disagreement.
A person competing for something.
To try to win against others.
To give reasons for a view.
To try hard against difficulty.
To keep saying something is true.

normalIntro.en: To contend is to pull hard, whether on a rope or on an argument.
normalIntro.cn: contend 就是用力拉，无论拉绳还是拉道理。

normal.en: Tendere means to stretch.
normal.cn: tendere 意为拉伸。

normal.en: Contendere means to strain with others.
normal.cn: contendere 意为与他人一并用力。

normal.en: Teams contend for one cup.
normal.cn: 各队争夺同一座杯。

normal.en: Lawyers contend that a rule is unfair.
normal.cn: 律师主张某规则不公。

normal.en: You contend with noise and with rivals.
normal.cn: 你既与噪音周旋，也与对手较量。

abstract.en: A rope pulled taut by two sides.
abstract.cn: 被两边拉得笔直的绳。

abstract.en: Two voices rising in a room.
abstract.cn: 屋里越抬越高的两个声音。

abstract.en: A runner leaning at the line.
abstract.cn: 在终点线前倾身的跑者。

examples.en: Three firms contend for the contract.
examples.cn: 三家公司争夺这份合同。

examples.en: She contends that the data is wrong.
examples.cn: 她坚称数据有误。

examples.en: The town contends with heavy traffic.
examples.cn: 这座城要应对严重拥堵。

dict_mnemonic.text: con（一同）+ tend（伸展用力）→ 一同较劲，即竞争、争论。

root: 拉丁 con（一同）+ tendere（拉伸）→ contendere（较劲）→ 英语 contend

sensesIntro.en: Pulling against a rival, or pulling a claim into the open.
sensesIntro.cn: 与对手彼此拉扯，或把主张拉出来辩明。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a rope pulled taut between two sides
core.cn: 核心意象：两边拉得笔直的绳

branches.en: Teams chasing one cup.
branches.cn: 追同一座杯的各队。

branches.en: Bidders raising one price.
branches.cn: 不断抬价的投标者。

branches.en: A lawyer stating a claim.
branches.cn: 律师陈述的主张。

branches.en: A family coping with noise.
branches.cn: 应付噪音的一家人。

branches.en: Strain turned into competition or speech.
branches.cn: 用力化为竞争或言辞。

intro.en: Contend joins the stretching root tendere to con-.
intro.cn: contend 把表「拉伸」的词根 tendere 接上 con-。

latinIntro.en: Latin tendere is to stretch and contendere is to strain with others.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tendere 意为拉伸，contendere 意为与他人较劲。

definition_en: what is inside or written in something, or feeling happy and satisfied
core_image: 翻开一本书，满页的字与图铺在眼前
scene: 她翻到目录，看这本书到底讲了哪些章节。The content of the report surprised everyone.
sceneCN: 这里 content 指「内容」（第 1 个义项：书或文件里写的东西）；句意是这份报告的内容让所有人吃惊。

senses.title: What is written or shown
senses.definition: the ideas, words or images held in a book, film or site
senses.definitionCN: 书、影片或网站里承载的想法、文字或图像
senses.example: The content of the letter was short but clear.
senses.exampleCN: 这封信的内容简短而清楚。
senses.why: A cover tells you nothing about what it protects.
senses.whyCN: 封面对于它所保护的东西一无所知。

senses.title: The amount inside
senses.definition: the amount of a substance held in something
senses.definitionCN: 某物内部所含某种物质的量
senses.example: Check the sugar content on the label.
senses.exampleCN: 看看标签上的含糖量。
senses.why: What a thing is made of can be printed as a number.
senses.whyCN: 一件东西由什么构成，能印成一个数字。

senses.title: Quietly satisfied
senses.definition: happy with what one has and not wanting more
senses.definitionCN: 对已有的事物满意而不求更多
senses.example: She felt content with her small garden.
senses.exampleCN: 她对自己那片小花园感到满足。
senses.why: The word that means held together also means at rest.
senses.whyCN: 表示「拢在一起」的那个词，也表示安心。

intro.en: Content comes from Latin contentus, the past participle of continere, held together, and so also satisfied.
intro.cn: content 来自拉丁语 contentus，是 continere（拢住）的过去分词，因而也含有「被满足」之意。

items.en: Continere meant to hold things together inside.
items.cn: continere 意为把东西拢在里面。

items.en: Contentus described something contained, and later a mind at rest.
items.cn: contentus 描述被容纳之物，后来也指安定的心。

items.en: The noun named what a thing held within it.
items.cn: 相应的名词指事物内部所盛的东西。

items.en: French content kept both the inside and the satisfied senses.
items.cn: 法语 content 同时保留内部与满足两层意思。

items.en: English content first meant what a writing held.
items.cn: 英语 content 最初指文字作品所包含的东西。

items.en: It now covers media material and the amount of a substance.
items.cn: 如今它涵盖媒体素材与某种物质的含量。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the contain- family, and the meaning group names other words for what fills a thing or a mind.
note.cn: 形近组共享 contain- 词族，近义组列出其他表示充盈之物或满足之情的词。

entries.definition: the things held inside something
to have something inside
feeling happy and satisfied
pleased because a need or wish is met
entries.definitionCN: 因需求得到满足而高兴的

entries.definition: the material that something is made of
facts or things used to make something

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a page full of print, then move to a number on a label and to a person who wants nothing more.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从印满字的书页开始，再到标签上的一个数字，最后到一个别无所求的人。

normal.en: Content is what a container holds, moved from things to words.
normal.cn: content 就是容器里的东西，从实物挪到了文字上。

normal.en: A thick cover hides a thin content, or a rich one.
normal.cn: 厚封面既可能盖着单薄的内容，也可能盖着丰富的内涵。

normal.en: Sugar content is content you can measure in grams.
normal.cn: 含糖量是能用克称出来的内容。

normal.en: To be content is to have enough and stop counting.
normal.cn: 满足就是觉得够了，不再往下数。

normal.en: The same word fills a book and calms a heart.
normal.cn: 同一个词既装满一本书，也安顿一颗心。

abstract.en: Picture an open book with dense small print.
abstract.cn: 想象一本摊开的书，满是细密的字。

abstract.en: Picture a label with one number circled.
abstract.cn: 想象一张标签上有一个被圈出的数字。

abstract.en: Picture a person sitting still with a cup of tea.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人端着一杯茶静静坐着。

examples.en: The content of the course is mostly practical.
examples.cn: 这门课的内容大多是实用的。

examples.en: This juice has a high sugar content.
examples.cn: 这种果汁含糖量很高。

examples.en: He was content to wait another hour.
examples.cn: 他愿意再等一个小时。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 content 记成 con（一起）加 tent（握住）：被一起握住、兜在里面的东西就是内容，兜得刚好就叫满足。

root: 源自拉丁语 contentus（continere 拢住 的过去分词），本义是被盛住、被围住，后指容器里的内容、物质的含量，又引申为内心安定的满足。

sensesIntro.en: From the words held inside a cover, to the grams held in a bottle, and to a heart that holds enough.
sensesIntro.cn: 从封面里装着的文字，到瓶子里装着的克数，最后到一颗装得下「够了」的心。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an open book whose pages are packed with print.
core.cn: 核心意象：一本摊开的书，书页上排满文字。

branches.en: The first sense is everything the cover keeps from view.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是封面挡在视线之外的一切。

branches.en: The second sense weighs the inside in grams.
branches.cn: 第二个义项用克来称里面的东西。

branches.en: The third sense says a person can also be full and at rest.
branches.cn: 第三个义项说人也能装满而安歇。

branches.en: Both senses ask what a thing is carrying inside it.
branches.cn: 两个义项都在问一件东西里面装着什么。

branches.en: Enough sugar and enough peace are both a kind of measure.
branches.cn: 足够的糖与足够的安宁，都是一种度量。

intro.en: Content is built on Latin com-, together, plus tenere, to hold: what is held inside.
intro.cn: content 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 tenere（握住）构成，指被拢在里面的东西。

latinIntro.en: The Latin hold base tent- also appears in contain, retention and maintain.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的握持词基 tent- 也出现在 contain、retention 与 maintain 中。

items.meaningCN: 被拢在某物里面的东西
items.example: The content of the box was a mystery.
items.exampleCN: 盒子里装的是什么仍是个谜。

items.meaning: the list or the things inside
items.example: She checked the contents of the bag.
The cat looked contented by the fire.
items.exampleCN: 那只猫在炉火边显得很满足。

items.meaning: the state of wanting nothing more
items.example: A simple meal gave him contentment.
items.exampleCN: 一顿简单的饭就让他很知足。

items.meaning: an object that holds other things
